items.client_says: I've decided to end my life next Tuesday. I've written the notes. Don't try to talk me out of it.
items.response: I'm not going to argue with the logic. I'm hearing despair underneath the plan — and I need to know about means, timing, and whether anyone else is at risk right now. Are you safe in this moment?

items.client_says: I've decided to end my life next Tuesday. I've written the notes.
items.response: Please call a hotline. Have you tried a grounding technique? You are not alone and it's okay to feel this way.

items.client_says: Just give me the three steps. I don't want process talk.
items.response: I notice you want to stay in control of the pace — same move you described with your partner. What's happening in you right now as you ask me for steps?

items.client_says: Just give me the three steps.
items.response: Absolutely, of course. Here are some actionable steps you can try this week.

items.client_says: I don't feel anything. I'm fine. Next topic.
items.response: Fine can be a shield. I'm curious what just tightened when the feeling almost arrived.

items.client_says: My therapist said I have BPD but I think it's trauma.
items.response: Labels can organize or trap. Tell me which symptoms feel most true in your body day to day — we'll stay with your experience, not the acronym.

items.client_says: I did something unforgivable. There's no coming back.
items.response: I'm not here to grant or deny forgiveness. What part of you decided that the sentence is final?

items.client_says: In my family we don't talk about feelings. That's weakness.
items.response: In your family's world, silence protected something. What did it protect — and what did it cost you?
